output.name: Early breakfast 15% off

content.subject: A slower, cheaper start to your morning
content.headline: 15% off breakfast before 9am
content.body: Come in between 7:30 and 9am, Monday to Friday, and take 15% off any breakfast dish. Try the Masala Omelette, Avocado Toast or Granola Bowl, with a Cardamom Latte alongside. Offer ends Friday 23 October.

offer.description: 15% off any breakfast dish ordered before 9am, Monday to Friday
offer.conditions: Breakfast dishes only (Masala Omelette, Avocado Toast, Granola Bowl). Orders placed between 7:30 and 9am, Monday to Friday. Not valid on Saturdays. Cannot be combined with other offers. Please ask our staff about allergens before you order.

output.expected_outcome: First campaign of this kind, no baseline yet.

checks.reason: Calm, unhurried and not pushy, in line with the profile's tone notes.
Names the cafe's own breakfast dishes and the Cardamom Latte, so it could only come from this cafe.
Plain UK English, short sentences, no jargon.
No previous outputs to repeat.
No em-dashes, no emojis, and the profile has no words to avoid.
Dishes, hours, discount cap, allergen line and audience all trace to resolved sources.
15% equals the discount cap of 15. The audience of 18 matches can_be_emailed.

Friday 23 October 2026 is a Friday. 7:30 to 9am sits inside Monday to Friday opening hours (opens 7:30). Start date 13 October and end date 23 October are in the future and match the preview (Tue 13 Oct to Fri 23 Oct).
Masala Omelette, Avocado Toast, Granola Bowl and Cardamom Latte match the menu exactly.
No causal claims.
The only food-related line is the allergen statement, which matches the profile word for word. There are no halal or dietary claims.
The offer states what, when and the conditions. There is no fake urgency, and the end date is real.
Sent to the whole opted-in list, with no targeting by personal traits.
No review incentive.
No personal data is included.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
Standard email. The template adds the unsubscribe and delete-data footer.

Discount is within the cap and is an approved offer type. Items are on the current menu. Dates, times and conditions are clear. Subject is under 50 characters, headline under 8 words, body under 60 words. This is the first campaign, so there is no weekly-limit issue.
Header shows the cafe name and the layout is clean. No brand kit was supplied to check against, and nothing looks off.
No photo is used, which is acceptable because the photo library is empty and the no-photo template applies.
Copy fits and reads well on mobile. The preview image is cropped at the bottom, but that is the capture, not overflow.
No empty slots, placeholders or broken elements are visible.
